Package jaba

package jaba
The JABA tool: identification of bottlenecks in multiclass closed product form networks using efficient convex hull algorithms, as described in the user manual. Up to three customer classes are supported; optimization studies are performed through the identification of the saturation sectors, the mixes of customer classes in execution that saturate more than one resource simultaneously.
